@switch a model=D100-24T-4X os=demo name=sw1 serial=DM2601-00001
@switch b model=D200-8T os=demo name=sw2 mgmt=10.99.0.12/24
@cable a 25 b 8
@prompt sw1>

@prompt *sw1#
> save
> y
saved
@prompt sw1#
> ping 10.99.0.12 vr mgmt

> ping 10.1.1.2

> ping 10.5.5.5
no route to 10.5.5.5
@on b
> enable
> config
